pose_rule: Rear staggered lunge: left foot planted forward, right foot on its toe behind, left knee bent, torso upright, and hands resting on the left thigh.
prompt: Use the supplied front full-body reference as the fixed source for the entire figure and pose change. Use the supplied ordered face sheet to preserve the same face and hair across its front and target-direction panels. Render the same full-body figure, strict rear back-of-head view facing away from the camera, Rear staggered lunge: left foot planted forward, right foot on its toe behind, left knee bent, torso upright, and hands resting on the left thigh. Preserve full-body proportion, clothing silhouette, and the plain off-white studio background. One person, complete limbs, no text or labels.
hard_fail_conditions: The figure does not show exactly two arms, two hands, two legs, and two feet.
Any limb, hand, or foot is extra, missing, fused, duplicated, or cropped.
Any visible hand does not show five separate fingers including the thumb.
The pose, view, face identity, or clothing silhouette does not match the supplied Stage-1 references.
decision: Human approved as an unstyled Stage-1 pose anchor; use only as input to Stage 2, not directly for LoRA training.
